meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes before a client call, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class. Who decided that, and when?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.

A rewrite for what, and on what evidence? If Owen sits a rewrite with nothing on the table, that admits something he never did. And you still haven't told me who entered that zero before anyone called me.
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
Generous. I'm not most parents, Hale, and I'm still waiting to hear who decided on the zero and on what basis.
Will you take it or not?
No. Show me what you have against Owen's essay, or the zero comes off and I'm going to the principal.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, an apology for how it was entered, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen's record kept clean. The fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but you never showed any evidence, so the meeting couldn't get there.
What moved her: Nothing, because each offer came with no document behind it.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence and then pressed her to accept it; to her, taking it would have meant admitting something with nothing on the table.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero and when, own entering it before calling home in one sentence, then show a dated document tied to Owen's essay before you offer the rewrite.
